label: Figure 14.3: Shifts in aggregate demand
alt: Three parallel downward-sloping AD curves: AD3 on the left, AD1 in the middle and AD2 on the right, with purple arrows from AD1 to AD2 and from AD1 to AD3.
caption: The original curve is AD<sub>1</sub>. An increase in aggregate demand shifts the curve right to AD<sub>2</sub> (more real output demanded at every price level); a decrease shifts it left to AD<sub>3</sub>. The purple arrows show each shift from AD<sub>1</sub>.
